notes: Ruled 2026-11-17 (kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-17-rulings-pb5789-folios.md, corrected by kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-17-rulings-code-reads-batch-23.md) against the printed folios transcribed from the GovInfo scan (kb/Work PB5789). The printed §1985:XIII.3.20.2 admits TYPE [IS] RH/PH/DE/PF/RF (each long or abbreviated) or {CONTROL HEADING | CH} {data-name-1 | FINAL} / {CONTROL FOOTING | CF} {data-name-2 | FINAL}: an operand is required, with no ON/FOR and no OR PAGE. VersionConformancePass refuses the omitted operand, ON/FOR and OR PAGE at 85 (COBOL0900; pb5116-control-heading-without-operand-at-85); every long and short spelling compiles and runs (l1c34_report_type_abbreviations). The operand is a data-name, and §1985:III.2 says a 'data-name' "must not be reference-modified, subscripted, or qualified unless specifically permitted by the rules of the format". The printed TYPE clause permits none of the three (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR4 asks only that the operand "must be specified in the CONTROL clause of the corresponding report description entry"), while the CONTROL clause permits qualification (§1985:XIII.3.7.3 SR1). So at 85 a QUALIFIED TYPE operand is refused under §1985:III.2 (COBOL0900, report-type-operand-qualification-2002; pb5910-type-operand-qualified-85, OF and IN; kb/Work PB5910), a reference-modified one is refused (COBOL0900; pb5573-type-control-ref-mod-85, pb5910-type-operand-ref-mod-85) and a subscripted one is refused at every edition (COBOL0899; pb5910-type-operand-subscripted-85). The CONTROL clause's qualified operand with a plain TYPE operand compiles and runs (pb5573_qualified_control_name_85). ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.55.2 SR10 first permits the qualified and reference-modified TYPE operand (§2023:13.18.57.3 SR10). The basis §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 the earlier ruling accepted is withdrawn (batch 23): it asks for qualification only where qualification is permitted. CONFORMS. retired-witness: conformance:cases/13.18.16-CONTROL/pb5573_control_name_ref_mod_2002 (1985-FMT-XIII_3_9_2 fails at 85 on a missing PICTURE, not on the TYPE clause (ruling, kb/Work PB5683); pb5573_control_name_ref_mod_2002 does not run at 85) retired-witness: conformance:cases/XIII.3.9@1985-REPORT-GROUP-DESCRIPTION-ENTRY/1985-FMT-XIII_3_9_2 (1985-FMT-XIII_3_9_2 fails at 85 on a missing PICTURE, not on the TYPE clause (ruling, kb/Work PB5683); pb5573_control_name_ref_mod_2002 does not run at 85)
